_comment: All of United States (data/regions/us.geojson, admin level 2). Generic North American rules come from _north-america.json; only what differs from Canada is here.

exemptions.reason: Amtrak's own track in and around Penn Station New York and Washington Union Station. Tagged usage=main with no freight tag, but no station node sits within 200 m, so the no-station test calls it freight.
Metro-North commuter lines (usage=main or branch, no freight tag) that the no-station test calls freight because the stations are not within 200 m of these ways.

exemptions.reason: Long Island Rail Road passenger branches and the Penn Station terminal tracks (usage=main or branch, no freight tag), typed freight by the no-station test. The Montauk Branch is left out: some of its ways are tagged railway:traffic_mode=freight.
NJ Transit's Philadelphia to Atlantic City passenger line (usage=main), typed freight by the no-station test.
